summary: A waitress at an Applebee's restaurant in Madisonville, Kentucky recorded the names and banking information of 46 customers in a notebook while serving them and used the information fraudulently, taking at least $1,026.92. Police began investigating on July 27, 2026 and arrested the employee on August 4, charging a receipt or credit card violation.
